items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: In the meantime, my brother Buddy, when I moved to Columbus Buddy now was like 11 years old because...he was a lot younger. So I didn't know him; he was a total stranger... we were to each other, you see. He was just a baby when I left.

ctx.x: As I understand it, isn't that the way all of you started? Did anybody in your family ever have lessons?

No, not that I knew of, unless Buddy and Wes sneaked out somewhere, there was no formal training whatsoever. As I was explaining, about that period that we were in Columbus, at the age of 9...My folks had separated and at the age of 9 I was left...my mother...let me see. Wes and my older brother -- his real name was Thomas and they called him June. He was a "junior" so they all called him June -- the three of us (June, myself and Wes) had gone to Columbus to spend some time with my dad. We had gone for the…
